identity.name: Bloomberg News
identity.description: A global financial news agency and data operation covering markets, companies, economics, politics and technology for professional and general audiences.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Bloomberg News is a division of privately held Bloomberg L.P., majority-owned by Michael Bloomberg. The terminal and data business gives it unusually deep access to financial-market information.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Bloomberg's editorial standards stress independence from the commercial terminal business; ownership is private but the newsroom has a public editor and correction process.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Bloomberg Left-Center with High credibility, though its core financial file is market-oriented and technocratic rather than partisan.

economicPerspective.evidence: Coverage is built around market signals, corporate results and investor audiences, with a generally market-friendly analytical frame.

internationalAlignment.evidence: A US-headquartered global financial wire with a strong dollar, Wall Street and G7 policy lens.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates credibility High; Bloomberg is a primary source for market-moving corporate and economic news, with corrections and named sourcing.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; credibility High; factual rating not parsed in this review (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Market-first, data-rich wire coverage. Bloomberg explains politics and policy through their effect on companies, investors and the global economy.

selectionRationale: Provides fast, high-authority financial and corporate coverage that complements Reuters/AP and specialist regional outlets.

research.researchNotes: Official company page blocked the research client with 403. Ownership and leadership verified through Wikipedia and feed metadata. Two public feeds validated. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
